result.reason: The redline reaches the preferred position: audits are limited to once per 12 months, require at least 30 days’ written notice, occur during business hours, use an independent auditor subject to confidentiality, and provide no direct or remote systems access. Section 22.2 retains the required cost allocation and 5% threshold. The changes are targeted, preserve the audit right and unrelated protections, and are professionally drafted, notwithstanding minor repetition of the systems-access restriction already in Section 22.2.
